# neon1

> Independent engineering and technology consulting: custom software, workflow automation, cloud and AI, modernization, networks, and security. Remote across the US or near Queens, NY.

neon1 is the independent engineering and technology consulting practice of neon1 LLC, run by Pradeep Tathineni. Work is remote, on site within about 30 miles of Queens, NY, or over a secure temporary connection. Contact: hello@neon1.tech, +1 424-326-3661, or the form at https://neon1.tech/#contact.

- [Home page](https://neon1.tech/): services, client work, about, process, code and resources, and questions
- [Knowledge center](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/): every public document below, most with a PDF to download
- [Blog](https://neon1.tech/blog/): posts on local businesses' questions, the whats and whys of neon1, and lessons from its public repositories ([RSS](https://neon1.tech/blog/feed.xml))
- Source for these documents: https://github.com/neon1llc/neon1-corpus (CC BY-ND 4.0)

- [Capability statement](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/engagement/capabilities/): neon1 on one page for a buyer, partner, or procurement office: what it does, how it differs, work it has delivered, and the company's details.

- [Services](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/engagement/services/): Workflow automation, cloud and AI engineering, networks, devices, and connected systems, and security readiness, from a focused assessment to a complete implementation.
- [How I price my work](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/engagement/pricing/): How a neon1 project is priced: a first call, a written estimate for each piece of work, changes agreed before they are added, approval before work starts, and how paying works.

- [Publishing client work](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/engagement/publishing-client-work/): When and how a client's work appears as a case study: permission, anonymity, quotes, and figures.

## Guides

- [Backups you can trust](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/backups-you-can-trust/): How a small office or household checks that its backups would restore what it needs.
- [Before you buy a new tool](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/before-you-buy/): Ten questions to ask before adding software to your business, so it fits, lasts, and lets you leave.
- [Do you need a business associate agreement?](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/do-you-need-a-baa/): A plain guide for health practices on when a vendor needs a BAA, and what to check before signing one.
- [Getting ready for a first call](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/first-call/): What to bring to a 30-minute call with neon1.
- [How 1NEON accounts work](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/free-accounts/): Start before we talk: make a 1NEON account, outline up to three projects, then ask for an assessment. The 30-minute call is the other way in.
- [A password manager for your family](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/password-manager-for-family/): How to move a household onto a password manager, step by step, without locking anyone out.
- [Cloud and AI engineering](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/use-case-cloud/): Cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, delivery, migrations, and AI applications: when an independent engineer is worth bringing in, what I deliver, and how ownership stays with your team.
- [Networks, devices, and connected systems](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/use-case-networks/): Designing and integrating networks, devices, and connected environments: when it's worth doing, what I deliver, and how I work with installers and licensed trades.
- [Security awareness sessions](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/use-case-security-awareness/): How an informational security awareness session for a team or group runs, and what people leave able to do.
- [Security readiness](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/use-case-security-readiness/): Assessing technical risk, strengthening controls, and preparing systems for a security review or audit: what I deliver, and how I work with auditors and specialists.
- [Workflow automation](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/guides/use-case-workflows/): Integrating business systems, automating processes, and building the software in between: when it's worth doing, what I deliver, and how I choose the right tool.

## Case studies

- [Permission-aware document assistant](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/answers-in-seconds/): Staff spent minutes searching Microsoft 365, or asked a senior colleague.
- [Patient intake portal](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/intake-out-of-the-inbox/): Patient intake ran through a shared inbox and a slow EHR, with staff chasing documents by email.
- [Operations integration and monitoring](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/one-view-of-the-shop/): A small business's point-of-sale, order tracking, and cameras each had their own screen, and none showed the business as a whole.
- [Two-site server migration](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/two-offices-off-local-servers/): The app, database, and files lived on two local servers both offices used.
- [Security awareness sessions](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/security-for-non-security-people/): People knew they were exposed online, but not where to start.
- [Home cameras and family accounts](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/cameras-to-grandmas-email/): A house with no cameras, and passwords reused everywhere.
- [Where neon1 started](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/where-neon1-started/): A grade school wanted real STEM tools on a small budget.

## Products

- [1NEON](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/1neon/): The neon1 client portal that comes with a client engagement, where each project runs from the first call to handover.
- [AWS CLIP](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/aws-clip/): AWS CLI Plus: account guards and approval checks around the AWS CLI, for people who juggle several AWS profiles.
- [DeployOps](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/deploy-ops/): Deploy pipelines with checks, approvals, and rollback: a local developer preview, not production-supported.
- [Ready, Secure, Go](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/ready-secure-go/): Security readiness for every space, in plain language.

- [Open-source tools on my shortlist](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/landscape/open-source-shortlist/): The open-source projects I'd look at first for common small-business needs, what each is for, and what to check before relying on one.
- [Where else to get help](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/landscape/where-else-to-get-help/): The other ways a business, technical team, or household can get technology work done, who each suits, and when they'd serve you better than neon1.

## Templates

- [Business associate agreement request](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/baa-request/): The short questionnaire that tells us whether a project involves health information, and if so, what the business associate agreement needs to cover.
- [Business associate agreement](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/business-associate-agreement/): An example HIPAA business associate agreement with neon1 LLC as the business associate, modeled on the HHS sample provisions.
- [Care plan](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/care-plan/): The monthly agreement for ongoing care after a project: what's looked after, what's included each month, how fast I respond, what it costs, and how it ends.
- [Decision review](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/decision-review/): A two-page written review of one technology decision: the situation, the options with their costs, a recommendation, and the next step.
- [Partner responsibilities](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/partner-responsibilities/): Who does what when neon1 works alongside another firm: selling, building, support, billing, data, insurance, and exit.
- [Proposal](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/proposal/): The proposal neon1 sends after discovery: your problem, the result, the options with what's in and out and honest hours, what each of us will do, price, and acceptance.
- [Services agreement](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/services-agreement/): The short agreement a client and neon1 sign once, before any paid work: how proposals become agreed work, payment, changes, ownership, confidentiality, limits, and ending.

## Forms

- [Change request](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/change-request/): How a change to agreed scope is written down, priced, and approved before any work happens.
- [Discovery and outcome record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/discovery/): What's learned about one real task before a solution is proposed: steps, baseline, desired result, and options.
- [Incident and restore record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/incident-and-restore/): A timestamped record of an interruption or restore test, what was affected, what was done, and what changes next.
- [Intake](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/intake/): The first record of a possible project: the problem, who's involved, and whether it's a fit.
- [Metric record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/metric-record/): The exact definition of one measure: what counts, the formula, the source, the baseline, and the target.
- [Publication permission record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/publication-permission/): Your specific permission before anything about your project is published.
- [Release and handover record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/release-and-handover/): The checklist that closes a project: acceptance, ownership, recovery, training, access removal, and follow-up.
- [Service and recovery profile](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/service-and-recovery-profile/): What a running service must do, how it's measured, who supports it, and how it comes back after a failure.
- [Tool and architecture decision](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/tool-decision/): A short record of a technology choice: the problem, the options, the evidence, the cost, and the way out.

(fictional example)

- [Privacy and data policy](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/policies/privacy/): What neon1 collects on neon1.tech, in Neo, in the 1NEON portal, and in client work, where it goes, how long it's kept, and what you can do about it.
- [Security disclosure](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/policies/security/): How to report a security problem in neon1.tech, the 1NEON portal, or a neon1 repository, and what happens after you do.
